verdict.rationale: Decagon is an enterprise AI customer-support SaaS platform, so outbound event webhooks are a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. Integrations, MCP tooling, Watchtower flagging and Browser Actions are adjacent features, not webhooks, and the OpenAPI probe found no published API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
